messages:
jon: hitting a weird case in py SDK streaming — async for output in SSE mode sometimes yields an empty string chunk after cancelling the iterator.
jon: repro is simple: create stream, async for chunk in client.stream(...): if some condition: break
jon: after break the background task still emits one final chunk and then raises RuntimeError('generator already executing') later during garbage collection
may: hmm can you paste minimal repro? which sdk version?
jon: sdk 0.9.4, here's a trimmed snippet:
jon: ```py
async with client.stream(model='redwood-llama') as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        if 'STOP' in chunk.text:
            break
# not awaiting s.aclose() explicitly
```
rachel: looks like aclose isn't being awaited in the async iterator close path. we handle close in __del__ finalizer which can run concurrently
jon: exact. on CPython GC it triggers and we get a cancelled task + random exception. It also leaks the background reader task.
may: sounds like two bugs: 1) iterator close not awaiting aclose, 2) background reader not cancelled properly
samir: can we add an async context manager to stream() so users use 'async with' and it's guaranteed? also typings for AsyncIterator[str]
rachel: PR idea: make stream() return an object implementing __aenter__/__aexit__ that ensures proper cancelation, and ensure __anext__ awaits _close_lock
jon: workaround for now: explicitly call await s.aclose() after break, or use try/finally with await s.aclose() in finally
jon: simple patch I tested: when break, call await stream._cancel_reader() — fixes leak but private API
may: can you open a bug ticket and include the snippet + traceback? I'll triage and assign to eng-runtime
jon: filed: https://redwood/issue/4012
dev-bot: Created issue #4012: 'py sdk stream finalizer race + reader leak' assigned to @rachel
rachel: I'll own the fix, target v0.9.5. Will add tests for explicit break, generator deletion, and aclose semantics
samir: also add typing overloads so IDEs show AsyncIterator[StreamChunk], not just Any
rachel: agreed — will add mypy stubs and update docs/examples to recommend 'async with' usage
jon: thanks! d'ya want me to try a patch review?
rachel: please, that'd be great. ping me when PR is up :thumbsup:
may: small note — add a simple e2e in pytest-asyncio using GC collect and ensure no pending tasks
jon: will do, thanks folks
